# Catch restore dialog focus regressions before release

## What & Why
The restore flow now relies on focus placement, keyboard trapping, Escape dismissal, and focus return. A committed browser regression test would protect those behaviors from being lost during future modal or import-flow changes.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage verifies focus moves to Cancel when the restore confirmation opens
- Tab and Shift+Tab stay within the restore dialog
- Escape and Cancel close the dialog without changing saved workspace data
- Focus returns to the Restore workspace trigger after either dismissal
